[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Welcome~ Customer~!</FONT>
This is a woodworking shop for firewood~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 14>歡迎~顧客~！</FONT>
這裡是柴薪木工店~

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Is there anything~ you're looking for~?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
有什麼~需要尋找的~嗎？

scripts.text:

Is there anything~ you're looking for~?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
有什麼~需要尋找的~嗎？

scripts.text: About the request.
scripts.translation: 關於請求

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Are you talking about a request~ customer~?
Could you wait a moment, please~?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
您說的是請求~顧客~？
請稍等片刻~？

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
The carpentry request...
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[木工]
木工的請求...
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I'm sorry, but it's confirmed that there's no request from our woodwork.
May I know what kind of request you've received? Customer~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
很抱歉，確認過我們木工店沒有發出請求。
請問您收到的是什麼樣的請求？顧客~

scripts.text: Request for firewood.
scripts.translation: 柴薪請求

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Aaah!!!
I'm sorry!
I don't think it's from the woodworking shop, but it's a personal request from the owner~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
啊！！！
對不起！
我想這不是木工店的請求，而是老闆的個人請求~

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 10>If the boss asked you to do it, you should've told me!</FONT>
May I have a moment, please? Customer?
I'll call the boss...
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 10>如果老闆讓您做的，您應該告訴我！</FONT>
請給我一點時間，好嗎？顧客？
我去叫老闆...

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 14>This gentleman is out and gone again!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 10>Did he go to the forest again!</FONT>
This can't be happening!!!
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 14>這位先生又不在！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 10>他又去森林了！</FONT>
這可真是...

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I'm sorry~ Customer.
The boss is out of the office right now.
scripts.translation:
[木工]
很抱歉~顧客。
老闆現在不在辦公室。

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I don't know when he'll be back.
If you're in a hurry, why don't you go to ^dd5555Payon Forest^000000?
You go <NAVI>[there]<INFO>pay_fild08,157,129,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[木工]
我不知道他什麼時候回來。
如果您很著急，不妨去^dd5555斐揚樹林^000000看看？
您可以去<NAVI>[那裡]<INFO>pay_fild08,157,129,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Welcome~ Customer~!</FONT>
This is a woodworking shop for firewood~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 14>歡迎~顧客~！</FONT>
這裡是柴薪木工店~

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Do you have any other business?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
還有其他事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Aaaah~~
I'm completely blown away today! I messed up!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
啊啊~~
今天真是徹底崩潰了！我搞砸了！！！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Aaaah~~
I'm completely blown away today! I messed up!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
啊啊~~
今天真是徹底崩潰了！我搞砸了！！！

scripts.text: Chief?
scripts.translation: 首領？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Who?
...
Did Lee Daegam send you?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
誰？
...
是李大監派你來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
How long has it been since you roasted it? Are you sending someone here again?!
Just pushing doesn't mean it's going to work!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
烤了多久了？你們又派人來了嗎？！
光靠催促可解決不了問題啊！

scripts.text: I came for the request.
scripts.translation: 我是來執行委託的

scripts.text: [Carpenter Firewood] Huh... Huh... Ah!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [木匠 柴薪] 啊... 啊... 啊！！！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Eheh~~!!
Aaaah!!!
<FONT SIZE = 16>That's right!!!!!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
嘿嘿~~！！
啊啊啊！！！
<FONT SIZE = 16>沒錯！！！！！！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Sorry!</FONT>
I came out for a while because I didn't have any progress on my work and I was so frustrated, but I didn't expect a customer to visit me.
What a shame!
Eheheh!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>抱歉！</FONT>
因為工作毫無進展，心情很煩躁，所以出來透透氣，沒想到會有顧客來訪。
真是太尷尬了！
嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It's the perfect timing!
Now that you've come all the way here, don't go back to the woodwork, come here and look at what the nasty beasts have done.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
真是時候正好！
既然你都來了，就別回去做木工活了，過來看看那些可惡的野獸幹了什麼好事。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It looks like they're hoofed guys like deer and wild boars, but...
Why are they so fierce when they're grazing in the woods!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
看起來像是鹿或野豬之類的蹄類動物，但是...
為什麼它們在樹林裡吃草的時候這麼兇猛啊！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It's the perfect timing!
Now that you've come all the way here, don't go back to the woodwork, come here and look at what the nasty beasts have done.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
真是時候正好！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
So, how is your investigation going?
Have you found those wild animals yet?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那麼，你的調查進展如何？
找到那些野生動物了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
What have you found, adventurer?
What have you got?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
你發現了什麼，冒險者？
有什麼發現嗎？

scripts.text: About the food that fell on the street.
scripts.translation: 關於掉在街上的食物

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
How could someone throw food on the street? Food is precious, it's such a waste!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
怎麼會有人把食物扔在街上呢？食物是很珍貴的，太浪費了！！

scripts.text: About wild animals.
scripts.translation: 關於野生動物

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I'm glad it fed some wild animals, but...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
很高興能餵飽一些野生動物，但是...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then didn't the wild animals come all the way here while picking up the food?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那麼，那些野生動物是不是邊撿食物邊一路走到這裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Who could have done such a strange thing...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
到底是誰做了這麼奇怪的事情...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Anyway, the adventurer took over the job, so I can see some clues!
With this momentum, we'll solve this before Lee Daegam goes crazy again...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
總之，既然冒險者接手了這項工作，我就能看到一些線索了！
趁這股勢頭，在李大監再次發瘋之前解決這件事...

scripts.text:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Ahem!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Do you have a factory~</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>咳！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>你們有工廠嗎~</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Ugh....
Eddga told me he was coming...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
唉....
虎王說他要來...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Lee Daegam, what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
李大監，您怎麼來了？

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh~~ Eheh~ It's nothing special~
I'm here to see if everything is going well~
scripts.translation:
[李大監]
哦~~ 嘿嘿~ 沒什麼特別的~
我來看看這裡的情況怎麼樣了~

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It won't work if you come all the time like this...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
您不能總是這樣頻繁地過來啊...

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh my~
It doesn't look much different from yesterday.
You didn't even start working on it, but I hear loud noises~
scripts.translation:
[李大監]
哎呀~
看起來和昨天沒什麼兩樣。
明明還沒開始動工，我卻聽到了很大的噪音~

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh... I... I...!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I can't work because the tools keep breaking down!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>If you're here to tease me, you're just disturbing me, so go back!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>啊...我...我...!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>因為工具總是壞掉，所以我沒法工作!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>如果您只是來嘲笑我的，那就別打擾我了，請回吧！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh my!
You don't have to yell that much. I'm going!
<FONT SIZE = 18>Hmph!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[李大監]
哎呀！
不用這麼大聲吼我。我走了。
<FONT SIZE = 18>哼！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh, that old man!</FONT>
Are you asking me to work or not? You're just increasing my temper again!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>那個老頭！</FONT>
您到底是讓我工作還是不讓我工作？您只會讓我更生氣！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
He's only disturbing me, let alone helping me with what I've entrusted with you.
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh my!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
他除了打擾我，對委託給我的事情毫無幫助。
<FONT SIZE = 14>真是的！</FONT>

scripts.text: About Lee Daegam.
scripts.translation: 關於李大監

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
As you've heard before, he is a great leader, ^123456Lee Daegam^000000, who left this job to me.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
如您之前所聽，他是一位偉大的首領，^123456李大監^000000，他把這項工作交給了我。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I'll be making a vacation spot for young people around here! What do you say!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
我要在這裡為年輕人打造一個度假勝地！您覺得怎麼樣！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I told you that construction would be difficult because it was an area full of monsters, but who knew that even wild animals would be such a problem?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
我告訴過您，因為這裡魔物眾多，施工會很困難，但誰能想到連野生動物都會造成這麼大的麻煩？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
In the meantime, he came to me a today and teased me like that...
If you can't solve this problem again, I think I should quit...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
在此期間，他今天還來嘲笑我...
如果這個問題再次無法解決，我想我應該辭職了...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then I'll be organizing my luggage in the cart.
Take a closer look at ^dd5555Broken Tools^000000.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那麼我要整理手推車裡的行李了。
請仔細看看^dd5555損壞的工具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
In the meantime, he came to me a today and teased me like that...
If you can't solve this problem again, I think I should quit...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

請仔細看看^dd5555損壞的工具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Oh my... Oh my...
How in the world could that happen...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
天哪... 天哪...
這到底是怎麼發生的...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
He was a grumpy gentleman, but he wasn't that bad of a person, so what happened...
Oh my...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
他雖然脾氣暴躁，但並不是個壞人，所以到底發生了什麼...
天哪...

scripts.text: - It contains broken tools. -
scripts.translation: - 裡面裝著損壞的工具。-

scripts.text: - Around the box, animal footprints are imprinted in disorder, and as the Carpenter Firewood said, they appear to be herbivorous footprints. -
scripts.translation: - 箱子周圍雜亂地印著動物腳印，正如木匠 柴薪所說，看起來像是食草動物的腳印。-

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
What do you say, adventurer?
You think you know something?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
冒險者，您怎麼看？
您覺得您知道些什麼嗎？

scripts.text: I think I need to look around a little more.
scripts.translation: 我覺得我需要再四處看看。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then look around carefully.
We have to start construction as soon as possible, so don't take too long.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那就仔細找找看吧。
我們必須儘快開始施工，所以別花太長時間。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Let me know if you find out anything while you take a look.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
如果你發現什麼，告訴我一聲。

scripts.text: - A closer look at the broken tools shows a blurry stain. -
scripts.translation: - 仔細檢視損壞的工具，發現上面有一塊模糊的汙漬。-

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Oh no!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>You can't eat that!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 16>糟糕！！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>那個不能吃！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>It smells delicious, but it makes you sick.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>雖然聞起來很香，但吃了會生病的。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>The things I ate in the forest were sweet and delicious, but the snake strawberries I picked up earlier were bitter!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>I'm angry!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 18>My stomach hurts!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我在森林裡吃的東西又甜又好吃，但我剛才摘的蛇莓卻是苦的！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>氣死我了！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 18>肚子好痛！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Even the friends who followed the food here went home angry!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>就連跟著食物氣味來的朋友們，也都氣呼呼地回家了！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>The road over there smells delicious, but that road is on the way to the village, so we, the mountain animals, will be in trouble if we go that way!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>那邊的路聞起來很香，但那條路通往村莊，如果我們這些山裡的動物走那條路，就會惹上麻煩！</FONT>

scripts.text: About the delicious smell.
scripts.translation: 關於那股香味

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>The smell from the front of the forest is connected to the road to the village.</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>But it doesn't matter if it smells good and it's bitter, angry, and gives a stomachache.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>森林前方的氣味與通往村莊的道路相連。</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>但不管它聞起來多香，如果它是苦的、讓人生氣、還會引起胃痛，那就無所謂了。</FONT>

scripts.text: Give him a strawberry.
scripts.translation: 給他一顆草莓

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Huh?</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>What are you giving me?</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>咦？</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>你要給我什麼？</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Are you really giving it to me?!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>It's delicious! Delicious!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>It's much better than the strawberries I ate in the forest!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>你是真的給我嗎？！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>好吃！真好吃！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>比我在森林裡吃的草莓好吃多了！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>You gave me delicious food, so I'll take you to the place you're curious about, with the delicious smell!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Follow me.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>既然你給了我好吃的食物，我就帶你去那個有香味、讓你好奇的地方！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>跟我來。</FONT>

scripts.text:

<FONT SIZE = 14>You gave me delicious food, so I'll take you to the place you're curious about, with the delicious smell!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Follow me.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>既然你給了我好吃的食物，我就帶你去那個有香味、讓你好奇的地方！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>跟我來。</FONT>

scripts.translation:
[???]
如果是腳印的話，它們一直延伸到那片森林深處。

scripts.text: Who's speaking?
scripts.translation: 是誰在說話？

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>I am Chulho.</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I~~ I'm a spirit from the forest.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我是哲浩。</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>我~~我是來自森林的精靈。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>There are many friends in the forest!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>森林裡有很多朋友！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Today, I'm playing in the forest waving branches, and other friends are flocking along the road.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>今天，我在森林裡揮舞著樹枝玩耍，其他朋友也沿著大路聚集過來。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>I followed you because I thought something interesting happened and you were walking so excitedly.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>因為覺得發生了有趣的事情，而且你們走得很興奮，所以我跟著你們。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Walking with everyone, it was quite fun because there were ^dd5555fruits and grains^000000. Things that were hard to see in the forest on the floor!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>和大家一起走很有趣，因為地上有^dd5555水果和穀物^000000。在森林裡很難看到這些東西掉在地上！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Then I saw an unusually ripe fruit on the floor, so I looked away for a moment and everyone left.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>然後我看到地上有一個異常成熟的水果，於是分神看了一眼，大家就都離開了。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>After everyone left, there were no delicious fruits left, but there were footprints everywhere. So... I followed them here.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>大家離開後，美味的果實都沒了，但到處都是腳印。所以...我就跟著腳印來到這裡了。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>How delicious was it to eat it without a trace?</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>吃得這麼幹淨，一點痕跡都不留，真好吃啊？</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 17>Oh!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>There's another great snake strawberry!!!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 17>哦！！！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>還有另一顆巨大的蛇莓！！！</FONT>

scripts.text:
- I got information that there was something to eat on the way the wild animals passed by.
Let's go back to firewood. -
scripts.translation:
- 我得知野生動物經過的路上有食物。
讓我們回到柴火工坊吧。-

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
- The food seems to be piled up.
Let's get closer and check. -
scripts.translation:
- 食物似乎堆積在一起。
讓我們走近看看。-

scripts.text:
- The food seems to be piled up.
Who would do something like this in a place like this??? -
scripts.translation:
- 食物似乎堆積在一起。
誰會在這樣的地方做這種事？？？-

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Here it is!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>It smells so bad here!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>Churup...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>找到了！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>這裡好臭啊！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>咕嚕嚕...</FONT>

scripts.text:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Cute!</FONT>
You punk!
What if you covet someone else's in the village?
scripts.translation:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 14>真可愛！</FONT>
你這朽魔！
要是你在村裡覬覦別人的東西怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>I didn't want it!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I just drooled!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我才不想要呢！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>我只是流口水了！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[???]
Besides, those are things you shouldn't eat!
scripts.translation:
[???]
而且，那些東西本來就不該吃！

scripts.text: [Chulho] Why?
scripts.translation: [哲浩] 為什麼？

scripts.text:
[???]
These days, ^dd5555mountain animals who are sick after eating what they fell on the road^000000 keep coming to me, and it's all because of them.
scripts.translation:
[???]
最近，^dd5555那些吃了掉在路上的東西后生病的山裡動物^000000一直來找我，都是因為他們。

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Kisul is nice!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Are you worried about your stomachache?</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>基蘇爾真好！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>你擔心自己肚子疼嗎？</FONT>

scripts.text: [Kisul] I came to scold those who sprayed strange things because it was annoying to keep coming.
scripts.translation: [基蘇爾] 我來教訓那些亂噴奇怪東西的人，是因為它們一直來騷擾，很煩人。

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
...

[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 18>Good boy!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 18>好孩子！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Kisul]
Shh!
Seeing that you can hear the running sound, you must have finally discovered it.
scripts.translation:
[基蘇爾]
噓！
既然你能聽到奔跑的聲音，說明你終於發現了。

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 10>What?</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 10>什麼？</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Kisul]
I've been playing a little trick on you to see the faces of the old white guys who bothered me.
Stay still.
scripts.translation:
[基蘇爾]
我一直在耍點小把戲，想看看那些騷擾我的老白鬼的臉。
別動。

scripts.text:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Sir!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>大人！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Sir!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>We're in trouble!!!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>大人！！！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>出大事了！！！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
What's the matter?
Please explain quickly.
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
怎麼了？
請快說。

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam's Subordinate]
I put it in the barn... The...the food is all gone!
scripts.translation:
[李大監的下屬]
我把它放在穀倉裡了... 那...那些食物全都不見了！

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
<FONT SIZE = 14>What!?</FONT>
Where did all the food go!
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
<FONT SIZE = 14>什麼！？</FONT>
所有食物都去哪了！

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam's Subordinate]
The barn door was locked well, I was in the yard the whole time and no one passed by.
scripts.translation:
[李大監的下屬]
穀倉的門鎖得很好，我一直都在院子裡，沒有人經過。

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
So you're saying the food walked out on its own?!
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
你是說食物自己長腿走出去了？！

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
Well...
First of all, call a person to investigate the barn quietly. Next, tell them to go to the kitchen and prepare a meal quickly because they need food for immediate use.
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
嗯...
首先，派人悄悄去調查一下穀倉。然後，讓他們去廚房趕緊準備飯菜，因為我們需要立刻進食。

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
Then go to the men's quarters and tell them to come to Kwang Saeng.
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
然後去男兵宿舍，告訴他們來見光生。

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam's Subordinate]
Yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[李大監的下屬]
是，長官。

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
Sigh~
What a ghost!
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
唉~
真是個幽靈！

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
<FONT SIZE = 14>I don't know who it is, but I better not catch you stealing in my barn!!!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我不知道你是誰，但我要是抓到你在我的穀倉裡偷東西，你就死定了！！！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Kwang Saeng]
Lee Daegam, you're looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[光生]
李大監，你在找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Aaah~~!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>Kwang Saeng!!!</FONT>
How did you get here so soon?!
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
<FONT SIZE = 16>啊~~！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>光生！！！</FONT>
你怎麼這麼快就來了？！

scripts.text:
[Kwang Saeng]
I came quickly because you said you were looking for me in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[光生]
因為你急著找我，所以我來得很快。

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
It's not much, but there was a thief in the barn, and all the food disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
沒什麼大事，只是穀倉裡進了個小偷，所有的食物都不見了。

scripts.text:
[Kwang Saeng]
Oh no!
scripts.translation:
[光生]
哎呀！

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
That's why we're trying to catch the criminals, but we need to make new food for the people right now...
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
所以我們正在設法抓住罪犯，但現在我們需要立刻為人們準備新的食物...

scripts.text:
[Kwang Saeng]
All right.
I'll get you some medicines.
scripts.translation:
[光生]
好的。
我去給你拿些藥。

scripts.text:
[Kwang Saeng]
By the way...
I'm preparing medicine ^123456because^000000 Lee Daegam asked me to, but isn't the construction of the forest done by Lee Daegam himself?
Why don't you let me handle that?
scripts.translation:
[光生]
順便問一下...
我正在準備藥物，^123456因為^000000李大監讓我這麼做，但普勒斯特森林的建設不是李大監自己負責的嗎？
為什麼不讓我來處理呢？

scripts.text:
[Admiral Lee Daegam]
It takes effort to buy good land for cheap.
scripts.translation:
[李大監提督]
用便宜的價格買到好地，可是需要費一番功夫的。

scripts.text:
[Kwang Saeng]
Haha.
Lee Daegam.
scripts.translation:
[光生]
哈哈。
李大監。

scripts.text:
[Kisul]
Oh, my~
What was that.
I wondered if there was a big reason, but it was a boring reason.
scripts.translation:
[基蘇爾]
哎呀~
剛才那是怎麼回事。
我還以為有什麼大事，結果是個無聊的理由。

scripts.text:
[Kisul]
Then I'll go home since my interest has cooled down.
scripts.translation:
[基蘇爾]
既然我的興趣已經消退了，那我就回家了。

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
Oh!
Are you not going to stop me?
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
哦！
你們不打算攔我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kisul]
No, well.
He's already in over his head, so wouldn't he take care of it?
scripts.translation:
[基蘇爾]
不，算了。
他已經深陷其中了，難道不會自己處理嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kisul]
It's gonna be fun to watch.
Hehehe.
scripts.translation:
[基蘇爾]
看下去應該會很有趣。
嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Gasp!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>That's right!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I'm in trouble!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>天哪！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>糟了！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>我惹上大麻煩了！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hyunrok will be in big trouble if he finds out that he gave strange medicine to his friends as well as digging through the forest to make something weird!!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>如果玄鹿發現他不僅給朋友們吃了奇怪的藥，還翻遍森林去搞那些奇怪的東西，那他就慘了！！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Let's go!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>Hurry up!!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 16>快走吧！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>動作快點！！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Kisul]
Then I'll go home since my interest has cooled down.
scripts.translation:
[基蘇爾]
既然我的興趣已經消退了，那我就回家了。

Oh!
Are you not going to stop me?
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
哦！
你們不打算攔我嗎？

[Chulho]

scripts.text: Read the letter.

scripts.text: Stop.

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
Dear {0}.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
親愛的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
It's a relationship just by touching your clothes...
The reason you entered this forest and the reason we met must be all fate that the heavens decided.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
僅僅是觸碰你的衣物...你進入這片森林以及我們相遇的原因，一定是上天註定的命運。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
I will never forget the grace that helped us in danger even though we did not see the relationship properly and were disrespectful in the immediate event.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
儘管我們未能看清彼此的關係，且在緊急情況下表現得有些失禮，但我永遠不會忘記在危難時刻幫助我們的恩惠。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
As Chulho said, I wanted to at least hold a feast to repay you, but staying in this Deep Forest for a long time is dangerous to those outside the forest, so I feel heavy to send them back in a hurry without even telling them a proper goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
正如哲浩所說，我想至少舉辦一場宴會來報答你，但長期留在森林深處對外界的人很危險，所以匆忙送他們回去，甚至沒能好好道別，讓我感到十分沉重。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
I'm sure you'll understand because I did it for you.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
我相信你會理解，因為我是為了你才這麼做的。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
And it's not a small reward for your help, but it's engraved in our souls so that we can call out our strength whenever we need help.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
這並非對你幫助的小小回報，而是銘刻在我們靈魂中的力量，以便在需要幫助時隨時召喚。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
Then, let's look forward to seeing each other again...
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
那麼，讓我們期待再次相見...
